messages:
Sahil: Heads-up — we need to lock down an error taxonomy and a minimal dashboard set for the new runtime telemetry export. Focus: timeouts, 5xx classes, OOMs, degraded-mode/fallback counts, and quota-triggered rejects.
Jordan: +1. Who's the owner for implementing the runtime metrics?
Lena: ops/runtime should own the metric names and tags. Platform will own dashboards/alerting.
Priya: Agree. Can we define concrete metric names and required labels today so infra can implement? 
Sahil: Proposal (simple):
- redwood.request_timeout.count {route, model, region, env, rollout_tag}  (client vs server timeout via label)
- redwood.response_5xx.count {code_family, route, model, region, env}  (code_family = 500, 502, 503 etc)
- redwood.oom.occurrence {node_type, model, region, env} 
- redwood.fallback.count {fallback_type, route, model, region, env}  (fallback_type=degraded_model, proxy, queued_drop)
- redwood.quota.rejects.count {quota_type, route, tenant, region, env}
Jordan: Nice. Two quick asks: 1) include rollout_tag for canary vs stable comparisons, 2) include request_latency.histogram by route/model for SLOs.
Priya: For 5xx we should capture upstream vs runtime. Can we add label origin={runtime, model_backend, infra_network}?
Lena: That's fine if runtime emits origin. Opsbot: metric configuration lint passed for names and labels (opsbot).
Sahil: Also we need guidance for cardinality limits. Keep labels small — prefer model_family not full model hash for the dashboard.
Jordan: +1 on model_family. For tenant-sensitive dashboards, platform can add tenant_id when available.
Priya: For OOM detection: runtime will emit oom.exit_code and oom.stack_sample as logs; metric should be a count plus last_seen tag. We'll correlate logs -> metric via trace_id.
Lena: On alerts: baseline idea — page on sustained 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m for prod routes, or sudden spike in fallback.count > 50% of normal rate. Thoughts?
Jordan: Let's avoid hard numbers in the doc; leave thresholds to SLO owners but create templated alerts. Templated alerts + a canary comparator panel.
Sahil: Dashboard layout suggestion: top row SLO overview (latency, availability), second row error breakdown (timeouts/5xx/OOM/fallback by region/model_family), third row quota/rejects + instrumentation health (missing labels, sample rate).
Priya: Important: metric sample rate for prefix caching and batching — include sampling_rate label so we can detect undercounting.
Lena: Runtime will add sampling_rate and rollout_tag. We'll emit metrics via Prom gateway to telemetry team.
Jordan: Who will add the panels in Grafana? Platform, but need JSON templates. Priya can you own templated panels?
Priya: I can create panel JSONs for the suggested layout. ETA EOW for basic set and canary comparator.
Sahil: Action items: 1) runtime team (Lena) validate metric names & implement stubs (deadline Wed) 2) Priya produce Grafana JSON panels (EOW) 3) Jordan/platform wire up dashboards and set templated alerts (next sprint) 4) opsbot to run metric-lint as CI.
Lena: Will add PR for metric emitters and include example metrics in README.
Jordan: I'll reserve a slot in next week's dashboard review to finalize thresholds and tenant views.
opsbot: CI check queued for metrics-schema-pr (#432) — lint OK so far.
deploy-bot: deploy started: telemetry-runtime:v2.3.1 -> staging
Priya: FYI when runtime deploys to staging, I'll validate panels against real metrics and flag mismatches.
Sahil: Thanks all — let's keep the convo in this thread and tag infra if we hit storage/cardinality issues. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Ping @Lena when you have the PR so I can review metric labels quickly.
Lena: will do.
